olivia: Quick sync following the precision profiles RFC. I'm proposing a small ops playbook + manifest fingerprinting approach so runtime treats profiles as first-class manifests, separate from model blobs. Will sketch gaps we need to cover.

sam: Sounds good. high-level ask: make it reversible and observable. The runtime should never silently swap in a manifest without a visible trace.

yvette: Observable + auditable. can we generate a stable fingerprint for each manifest that includes algorithm version? e.g. `fp_v2:sha256(manifest_bytes||schema_v2)` so we can query historical requests by fingerprint.

olivia: Exactly. call it `manifest_fingerprint` and include `fingerprint_algo` in metadata. That way older archives still decode.

sam: For rollback UX: runtime config should accept `manifest_binding: {policy: "pin|prefer|flex" , fallback_chain: [fingerprint]}`. pin => strict parity, prefer => try primary then fallback, flex => allow runtime heuristics.

yvette: Add a per-tenant `parity_mode` override. Some enterprise customers require exact numeric parity for compliance. We'll allow `parity_mode=strict` which will reject any unpinned manifest.

carlos: Ops note: when a manifest changes the quant scales or zero-points, memory layout might change. KV cache keys that embed quant offsets can misalign. We should include a `kv_compat` flag in manifest: `compatible|incompatible|requires-rewarm`. If incompatible, runtime should either flush or use per-request rewarm fallback.

olivia: Good call. We can also add a short `rewarm_hint` that lists expected hot prefixes to prime KV on switch.

yvette: For regressions detection, propose two detectors: 1) micro-eval delta using a canary prompt set (fast pass/fail) 2) distribution shift detector (rolling window stats on token perplexity, top-1 change rate, stop-token freq). If either exceeds threshold, trigger auto-fallback.

sam: How do we run micro-eval under low-latency constraints? runtime could run `preflight_samples=8` in the background on a new manifest and report `preflight_score` to telemetry. If fail -> don't flip traffic.

olivia: Implementation idea: manifest lifecycle flow: upload -> CI lint -> preflight (CI-run) -> publish as draft -> staged canary (runtime fetches draft and runs shadow preflight on production traffic at 0.5%-2%) -> promote. We'll store `preflight_id` and `preflight_result` on manifest metadata.

yvette: Migration: for models with embedded profiles, provide a `manifest-extract` tool that emits a manifest and a `binding_map.csv` rows: model_hash,fingerprint,compat_flags. Runtime reads `binding_map` until customers re-pin their endpoints.

sam: Shadowing details: use a dual-exec path where shadow invocations are async and don't impact latency SLO. sample both outputs and compute a tiny similarity metric (BLEU-ish or token overlap). Keep it cheap.

yvette: Also add `validation_algorithm_version` to manifest so we don't mix hashes across algos. store that in telemetry for queries.

carlos: Operational APIs: `GET /manifests/:fp`, `POST /manifests/:fp/preflight`, `POST /manifests/:fp/promote`, `POST /manifests/:fp/rollback`. Add `dry_run=true` flags for Private customers.

olivia: Billing note: if runtime falls back to higher-precision manifest, we should tag the request with `fallback_charge_tag` and emit cost delta events so billing can attribute.

sam: Edge-case: concurrent background warmups. if multiple manifests are promoted quickly, KV churn could thrash GPU memory. Add a global `manifest_switch_rate_limit` and `cooldown_s` per worker.

yvette: Lint rules to add in CI: ensure scale factors within sane bounds, warn on aggressive truncation policies, require `kv_compat` annotation if layout-affecting keys exist.
\ocloud-bot: infra-bot: manifest-service v0.9 deployed to staging at 2024-04-02T23:41:10Z :white_check_mark:

carlos: For private/dedicated CLI: `redwood-manifest apply --fp <fingerprint> --dry-run --promptset small` should exercise preflight locally and print a `pass|fail` with a small delta report.

olivia: I'll draft the ops playbook and schema with fields: fingerprint, fingerprint_algo, validation_algo_version, model_compat_tags, kv_compat, parity_mode_options, preflight_id, preflight_summary, rewarm_hint, manifest_epoch.

sam: Don't forget retention: how long do we keep manifests and preflight artifacts? default retention 90d but allow longer for enterprise.

yvette: And metadata for `created_by`, `approved_by`, and `change_reason` for audit trails.

olivia: Thanks all. I'll post the short RFC follow-up doc and a checklist for eng-ops. If anyone has more edgecases ping me.
